sam_sales: Heads-up — EmeraldCare (payer) wants a 3-week POC. Ask: SAML SSO (Okta + OneLogin), SCIM provisioning for ~95k objects, delegated admin across 5 subdomains, RBAC mapping (12 roles), private VPC connector and air-gap option. Also security questionnaire and firm POC estimate. Any blockers?
nina_se: Doable but call out: bulk SCIM import preferred for initial sync; recommend Dedicated for sustained delta rates at that scale. Delegated admin across domains requires domain verification (DNS TXT or SAML assertion). Need to know if they want SCIM over mTLS (Private only) or token auth.
sam_sales: They said they prefer mTLS for provisioning.
harry_sec: mTLS requirement pushes this to Private deployment. Also HIPAA scope — BAA required before any PHI touches our systems. We support BYOK; for Private, KMS stays in customer VPC and keys are never exported. Draft security line: "Customer-managed KMS supported; envelope encryption used; key material remains in customer KMS." Also we can stream audit logs to their SIEM or S3 with object-lock for immutability but legal must confirm retention terms.
mike_soleng: Quick POC checklist: 1) IdP SAML metadata (cert, entityID, ACS, logout), 2) SCIM client credentials + mTLS cert (if Private), 3) RBAC mapping CSV (group_external_id,group_name,role), 4) domain verification access, 5) network allowlist + proxy settings, 6) KMS info + signed BAA.
mike_soleng: Example RBAC CSV row: "clin-ops,Clinical Ops,clinical_ops"
mike_soleng: SCIM PATCH example (role replace): PATCH /scim/v2/Users/{id} Content-Type: application/json { "schemas": ["urn:ietf:params:scim:api:messages:2.0:PatchOp"], "Operations": [{"op": "Replace","path": "roles","value": ["clinical_ops"]}] }
nina_se: Certificate rotation: we support hot-swap with overlap window — upload new cert, schedule activation, old cert remains valid during overlap. Document that for questionnaire.
sam_sales: Cost ask: they want a firm POC number. Ballpark estimate for 3-week Private POC with connector + eng support?
mike_soleng: Ballpark: Private staging & connector engineering $22k, installer & runbook $8k, compliance/legal setup (BAA) placeholder $3k -> total ~$33k. If full air-gapped inference nodes needed + on-prem install, add ~$45k. Final quote after finance sign-off.
ticket-bot: ticket RED-37091 created (owner: nina_se) — https://redwood.atlassian.example/RED-37091
harry_sec: Also flag: when using delegated admin across many domains, conflicts can occur if multiple IdPs push different role mappings for same user; recommend source-of-truth guidance in POC and include conflict resolution policy in runbook.
sam_sales: I'll request SAML metadata, mTLS cert (if available), and sample RBAC CSV. I'll also send the questionnaire and loop legal for BAA. Posting updates here. :thumbsup:
